runtime_boundary: Native UMG only; no external executable, Lua renderer, motion bridge, diagnostic shared mapping, or connected PostRender/Present canary.
encounter_discovery_policy: One fixed weak slot per immutable Boss/Assault catalog entry is populated by the UObject creation listener. The existing 250 ms service walks all 49 slots round-robin, resolves the current exact-class Actor position before applying the 100-metre player-to-actor bound, and performs at most eight Actor-position queries per control tick. The observation refreshes its retained numeric position from that live actor instead of treating the static catalog coordinate as the actor position. Travel clears all 49 slots; F8/F7 preserves only valid same-world candidates. No FindAllOf, static catalog-distance prefilter, dynamic encounter queue, file polling, or 16 ms encounter work remains.
encounter_completion_policy: Ordinary disappearance arms after at least four present samples spanning at least one real second, then requires at least forty consecutive missing samples spanning at least ten real seconds while the player remains within 100 metres of the last actual actor position. A visible already-observed RemovedFromWorld edge may start, but never complete, that same missing window when a short Assault ended before ordinary arming. The ended weak UObject is cleared immediately. A cursor-owning map cannot erase this numeric-only ended evidence, although it still invalidates ordinary live weak-pointer disappearance. Unobserved removal, player departure, activity suppression, travel, unavailable state, invalid position, and a returned actor reject or reset missing evidence. Strict exact-class Destroyed EndPlay is the only immediate recovery path and still requires current availability plus bounded actor/catalog/player proximity.
encounter_availability_policy: The ordinary disappearance and strict Destroyed fallbacks pass the current time-window and future-cooldown gates at their final write. Exact NetMulticastNotifyDeath and schema-validated NetMulticastSetDeathProcess End events pass current availability before publishing a catalog bit; ordinary consumption does not recheck that accepted event's time window. A live actor return clears the missing sequence and requests only the existing compact rebind; effective availability changes reuse the existing fixed 49-bit visibility edge and deferred next-map-session atlas policy.
encounter_death_handoff_policy: An accepted exact NotifyDeath or DeathProcess End event sets one bit in one of two fixed 49-bit atomic masks. Ordinary consumption runs only in the existing 250 ms control service and requires enabled, non-transitioning, non-suppressed context with valid player position. Successful or deduplicated application clears that bit from both masks; an apply exception retains it without erasing unrelated or newly published bits. F7, disable, travel, and activity-suppression boundaries may settle pending cooldown and eligibility numerically without renderer mutation before reset. Only process shutdown and UObjectArray shutdown hard-clear the masks. No new poll, timer, scan, SQL query, dynamic queue, or steady work is introduced.
world_map_runtime_delta_policy: Rebuild in the current session only when the exact retained DLayerMap attachment is visibly open. An attached but hidden layer is retired and defers atlas work until the next exact SetWorldMapImage event. The matching serviced candidate serial may rearm the bounded three-attempt readiness budget once per layer, including after three early map_id probes exhausted before the renderer published a retryable failure; repeated same-layer delivery cannot replenish work after that one rearm.
compact_viewport_reflow_policy: Reuse the existing one-hertz minimap-scale service for two scalar viewport size/DPI queries. Mutate retained host scale, position, and layout only on a real geometry edge; add no 16 ms work, timer, enumeration, or allocation.
world_map_projection_anchor: Attach and each bounded event-local observation take the live PlayerIconWidget Canvas-slot alignment pivot, transform it from the player widget current cached Slate geometry through LocalToAbsolute, then into the live selected native icon Canvas current cached geometry through AbsoluteToLocal. Target X and Y scale independently by that selected parent's live parent-local width and height around the accepted parent-local player anchor. The exact retained native parent and current player-icon witness must agree even when Canvas identity is unchanged. Five finite 100/250/500/1000/1250 ms deadlines are serviced at no more than one observation per game-thread pass. The first four observations are read-only; only the final observation may mutate and only after geometry reaches Stable. A Stable extent change may consume one bounded rebuild for the current attachment baseline, and only a successful fresh attach establishes the next baseline. Only numeric anchor, extent, stability, timing, and rebuild-consumption state cross observations; no sampled UObject wrapper or FGeometry is retained. Missing, implausible, mismatched, or final unstable geometry fails closed; no desktop-resolution input, centered fallback, new poll, or per-frame projection path is published.

save_callback_limits.failure_policy: Every SQLite C callback contains C++ exceptions and fails the one-shot reconciliation closed on malformed, excessive, or allocation-failing input.

save_owner_boundary.retained_process_state: immutable catalogs, user visibility masks, configured treasure exclusions, and the event-only UObject creation listener

runtime_task_class_mapping.attempt_policy: one post-stability attempt and one delayed retry only after initial failure; success or the second failure stops work; completed travel may start a fresh bounded capture; an already-active explicit F7 rearms only failed capture and preserves completion bits, revisions, and reactivation latches
runtime_task_class_mapping.suppression_policy: confirmed non-open-world activity defers pending capture until open-world rendering resumes
runtime_task_class_mapping.retention: copied class-name strings and catalog indices only
runtime_task_class_mapping.failure_policy: classes used only outside the 147-entry catalog are ignored; a class shared by catalog and non-catalog IDs is ambiguous; missing schema, ambiguous class IDs, duplicate catalog coverage, incomplete coverage, and unmapped callbacks fail closed
runtime_task_class_mapping.completion_race_policy: exact completion increments a fixed per-task revision and clears its reactivation latch; stale scans and later still-active current scans preserve completion; current NONE or END arms reactivation, and only a later current ACCEPTABLE or PROGRESS sample restores a repeatable task and starts a new task generation; FAIL does not arm. Three non-confirming save attempts lock the current generation against repeated-event replenishment; only that two-scan reactivation or a new F7 unlocks it. InitGameState pre-transition drains any already published exact bits into numeric completion and prerequisite evidence before clearing mapping and atomic state, while pure numeric event witnesses retain only their original deadline across travel for the travel-end scan; no UObject is accessed or retained and F8/F7 remains a fresh resynchronization
runtime_task_class_mapping.save_merge_policy: a valid single-owner full F7 snapshot records the exact COMPLETE_CNT baseline for every requested catalog ID; an absent ID is baseline zero only for that valid query, while invalid or ambiguous ownership leaves the baseline unknown. An unresolved exact witness queues no SQL when its baseline is unknown. Otherwise it may request one immediate exact-ID confirmation and at most two retries spaced 15 seconds apart on the existing single below-normal worker; only strict count growth above the baseline confirms completion. Confirmations skip treasure SQL and are never periodic, and asynchronous results cannot erase newer exact or generic runtime completion evidence
runtime_task_class_mapping.delayed_result_atlas_policy: a result arriving after expanded-map attachment rebuilds immediately only when the exact retained layer is visibly open; a hidden or detached layer is retired and deferred until the next exact SetWorldMapImage edge

runtime_quest_event_witness.hook_kind: native pre-callback with reflected Locals parameters
runtime_quest_event_witness.event_filter: IsDynamic=true and QuestID is one exact entry in the 147-task catalog
runtime_quest_event_witness.arming_policy: IsDynamic must be true and QuestID must be one exact entry in the 147-task catalog. That exact event arms the numeric witness without a prior PROGRESS requirement, but the event itself is never completion.
runtime_quest_event_witness.additional_exact_sources: OnQuestBlueprintEndPlay and OnRenewQuestBlueprintEndPlay may arm only when the supplied task Actor class maps unambiguously through the complete 147-entry task-class table
runtime_quest_event_witness.witness_scope: per catalog task in one deduplicated fixed 147-entry numeric queue
runtime_quest_event_witness.coalescing_policy: each due witness queries only its exact catalog ID; all witnesses share the one-query-per-engine-tick budget, while repeated events for an already-live task do not extend its deadline or append a duplicate queue entry
runtime_quest_event_witness.completion_policy: final END proves the exact witnessed task complete even if its previous published state was NONE, FAIL, ACCEPTABLE, or PROGRESS; NONE alone is not completion and unwitnessed END remains fail closed; after completion, current NONE or END is only the inactive boundary for later repeatable reactivation
runtime_quest_event_witness.retention: numeric catalog index, boolean witness, steady-clock deadline, next 750 ms probe time, and one-byte probe count only; F8/F7 clears them; no event parameter, world context, task actor, or other UObject is retained
runtime_quest_event_witness.failure_policy: unknown IDs, non-dynamic events, invalid reflected schema, unverified final state, or an unknown F7 COMPLETE_CNT baseline cannot latch completion or queue confirmation SQL. With a known baseline, an expired exact witness may queue one fixed-bit exact-ID confirmation due immediately with at most two retries spaced 15 seconds apart; only strict count growth is accepted. Equal, lower, ambiguous, mismatched, unavailable, or failed results change no state. Three non-confirming attempts lock that task generation against repeated event rearming until a new F7 or current NONE or END followed by later ACCEPTABLE or PROGRESS; the bound never becomes periodic SQL

visibility_hub.config_write_policy: only on a real selection, area-quest mode, or Assault mode change via temporary-file atomic replacement in current readable format
visibility_hub.deployment_policy: preserve an existing user config file

runtime_diagnostics.read_policy: once during native construction; no hot polling
runtime_diagnostics.failure_policy: missing, unreadable, oversized, duplicate-section, duplicate-key, unknown-section, unknown-key, non-canonical Boolean, lone-carriage-return, or malformed input fails closed to disabled; log open, write, or flush failure atomically disables logging only

release_installer.discovery_policy: bounded Steam library and appmanifest discovery with one separately validated explicit game path fallback
release_installer.game_compatibility_policy: require the exact DragonSword executable path plus a bounded executable AMD64 PE32+ image; do not reject a game update by executable SHA-256; retain the observed SHA-256 only in the confirmed transaction identity and install record
release_installer.package_topology: one unsigned C# Setup archive containing exactly Setup, its SHA-256 sidecar, INSTALL.md, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt plus two script-free ExperimentalNested manual archives whose roots map directly to DS/Binaries/Win64. release_installer.integrity_policy: verify fixed embedded payload topology, manifest identity, exact file set, SHA-256, size, and release version before installation; existing game, UE4SS loader, and proxy hashes are transaction provenance only and are not compatibility allowlists; before replacing an existing same-name target, require schema-5 release and schema-1 package metadata, exact immutable installed path/size/hash identity including metadata/release.json and a runtime-label-bearing dlls/main.dll, strict mutable treasure-override syntax, and an exact bounded recursive tree
release_installer.mutation_policy: perform exactly three stopped-game checks before mutation; never elevate, launch, or terminate the game; replace only the exact native target, normalize one native mods.txt authority, remove every valid obsolete DragonSwordWorldRadarObjectState entry, and atomically preserve unrelated mods.txt encoding, line endings, bytes, and entries; reject active or malformed DragonSwordWorldRadar load control and exact DragonSwordWorldRadar/enabled.txt in any approved Mods root before backup or mutation, preserve exact disabled DragonSwordWorldRadar : 0, and never delete or disable that external renderer
release_installer.user_state_policy: preserve config/visibility.ini, config/diagnostics.ini, and data/defaults/treasure_overrides.txt byte-for-byte after strict validation; clean installs copy embedded defaults into the three live paths; example files are not installed
release_installer.rollback_policy: normal install and Update / Repair use a non-reparse temporary rollback journal that is removed after verified commit; only UE4SS bootstrap or conversion retains a complete verified original-layout backup; any failure restores every recorded mutation
release_installer.final_output: dist/final-2.1.0 contains exactly DragonSwordNativeWorldRadarPostRender-v2.1.0-Installer.zip, DragonSwordNativeWorldRadarPostRender-v2.1.0-Manual-No-UE4SS.zip, DragonSwordNativeWorldRadarPostRender-v2.1.0-Manual-With-UE4SS-v3.0.1-Beta0-g1c1a1497.zip, release-manifest.json, and SHA256SUMS.txt

save_owner_binding.runtime_policy: use the packaged length-bound RVA as the fast path; if it is stale or cannot yield a valid live key, scan executable PE sections exactly once on the existing below-normal save worker, require one unique in-image target, cache only its numeric process-lifetime candidate, and validate the live key before SQLCipher use
save_owner_binding.steady_state_cost: no watcher, periodic scan, game-thread scan, UObject retention, or additional worker; a compatible update pays at most one below-normal mapped-image scan per game process

update_policy: A game executable update does not block Setup and does not request reinstall or catalog rebuilding. F7 performs save/runtime resynchronization and may use the bounded owner-pointer fallback, but it does not extract PAK data or regenerate immutable catalogs. New or corrected catalog rows still require a separately validated data release. The runtime has no watcher, hot configuration polling, network updater, or automatic reinstall prompt.
